propositions: Reconciler core lacks a named Backend interface; today it reaches directly into Jira adapter modules without abstraction allowing for a second vendor backend.

Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three opt-in capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must be defined to model the backend contract.

JiraBackend must wrap existing Jira modules (AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields.py, comment_limits) as a pure delegation shim with zero behavior change and no rewiring of core call sites.

IdentityConvention must be a new self-contained pure object under adapters/jira/ that stamps RemoteRef to rebar-id label strings and parses labels back to RemoteRef, serving as the single source of the format currently hand-inlined at four core sites.

Backend-agnostic contract suite must validate outbound/inbound round-trips, sanitizer idempotency, capability detection via isinstance() over runtime_checkable Protocols, and identity convention round-trips using an injected mock transport and FakeBackend.
